title: Sensitive warnings and brake response
summary: This topic centers on complaints about overly sensitive brake feel and driver-attention warnings, with most sampled fragments lacking enough context for a clear sentiment classification.

negative.summary: The negative feedback describes brakes that feel excessively sensitive and require the driver to start slowing much earlier to avoid harsh braking.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention a forward-attention warning being too sensitive, a preference for lower sensitivity, and a warning that disappears in the garage, but the limited context prevents a clear sentiment label.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined and too brief to support a clear sentiment reading.
The topic appears to combine at least two subjects—brake sensitivity and warning-system sensitivity—so the sample may not reflect a single coherent issue.
Examples are limited to a small stratified sample and are not representative estimates.
